structured.reason: an alert is firing on a production service

entries.text: The liveness probe on /healthz timed out nine times and the kubelet restarted the container each time [e1]. There is no OOMKilled event and memory is within the limit, so this is not resource exhaustion. The last rollout was six days ago, so the deployment did not change.

structured.root_cause: the liveness probe timeout is shorter than the /healthz cold-start latency, so a working container is restarted
structured.summary: The liveness probe times out and the kubelet restarts checkout [e1]. There is no OOMKilled event and memory is within the limit, so the restarts are the probe's doing rather than a resource problem. All three replicas report Ready between restarts, which is why the service looks healthy at a glance.
causal_chain: the liveness probe timeout is one second
/healthz takes longer than that under load
the kubelet restarts a container that is working
remediation_steps: raise the liveness probe timeoutSeconds and add an initialDelaySeconds
split readiness from liveness so a slow start does not restart the container
recommended_actions: raise the liveness probe timeoutSeconds and add an initialDelaySeconds
